description_text:
Coat stand 3D Model, nr. 1 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 80298 vertices, 79630 quad faces (159260 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

Bae Se Hwa made his international debut in 2010, at the Design Miami Fair in Basel. Since then he has become a fresh sensation as a young Korean designer. Bae is best known for his dynamic collection of works called the “Steam Series”. This collection embodies emotional function as well as displaying a sense of calmness and serenity. In Bae’s “Steam Series” he utilizes a steam bending technique in which he distorts and deconstructs very linear wood elements and then recombines them into new pieces that are bent and curvilinear in form. PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 3522 vertices, 3500 quad faces (7000 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Low poly wooden dresser that was created using Blender.
This model uses a diffuse map for the colors, a gloss map to give certain parts a reflective and shiny surface, and an AO map for calculating shadows. The diffuse map was made from a wooden texture that was made using GIMP. Also included is a combined texture which combines the diffuse, gloss and AO maps together. The UV Layout of the UV Map is also included to show how the texture maps are laid out. This model can be purchased separately or in the Bedroom Furniture Asset Pack.
Features:

  - Model is exported in 4 file formats (FBX, OBJ, 3DS, DAE/Collada)

  - Textures are in PNG format

  - Textures are 2048x2048

  - Object has been unwrapped and its textures are baked to its UVMaps

  - 4 separate archive files for each exported file format along with their textures

  - All preview images were rendered using the cycles engine and were exported into PNG format

Included Textures:

  - DresserCombinedTexture

  - DresserDiffuse

  - DresserGloss

  - DresserAO

  - DresserUVLayout

Tatsumaki (タツマキ, Tatsumaki; Viz: Tornado), also known by her hero alias Tornado of Terror .
Most of my work is sculpted directly in Oculus Medium VR.Most objects are separate elements which means you can mix and match to achieve the effect you want.

If you enjoy what you see then give a like or comment to support more of this effort.

Vegeta, more specifically Vegeta IV. Vegeta the Fourth), recognized as Prince Vegeta is the prince of the fallen Saiyan race and one of the major characters of the Dragon Ball series. He is the eldest son of Vegeta III, the older brother of Tarble, the husband of Bulma, the father of Trunks and Bulla, and the ancestor of Vegeta Jr. Alongside Goku, Gohan, Bulma, Krillin, and Piccolo, he is easily one of the most prominent characters in the series, receiving more character development after being introduced than a number of other characters.
Regal, egotistical, and full of pride, Vegeta was once a ruthless, cold-blooded warrior and outright killer, but later abandons his role in the Frieza Force, instead opting to remain and live on Earth, fighting alongside the universe's most powerful warrior, specifically with the mission to defeat and surpass Goku in power. His character evolves from villain, to anti-hero, to a hero through the course of the series.

description_text:
UPDATE 7th JULY 2021:[Fixed broken shaders & Added native blend file for blender 2.8 and above]
Character's personality:
A nameless anime boy who tends to be a silent onlooker at the very back of a roaring crowd.This guy is inspired by Hachiman Hikigaya, Houtarou Oreki and Kiyotaka Ayanokoji.He is a loner but a smartass!
*Model info: *
Its a low poly model(a sub-surf ready one) fully rigged with custom bone shapes including some anime style poses. Original poly count is around 3.5k but Im using inverted hull method for outlines thus increasing the poly count to 7.5k
*Other: *
Im only uploading the .blend file; leaving the room for more modifications, feel free to edit it however you want. Also, there are three different lights for different parts of body which do not interfere with one another giving you the ability really to give that anime feel to it since according to Arc System Works, Each character should have their own lighting setup and shouldn't depend on background lighting.

description_text:
This Greek Hermes Helmet Package is based on the ancient armor of the gods. The helmet is perfect for mortal combat or gods of war.  This asset is perfect for fantasy characters or 3D printing enthusiasts.Our Greek Hermes Helmet Package is fully customizable. The template included in the package allows you to add your own custom color options. It was designed for a standard height figure (186 cm) in Cinema 4D and Zbrush. This package is ideal for game assets, illustration, and animation. It’s sized for standard figures in Unity, Poser or Daz Studio. I’ve broken the model down into its basic components for ease of customization. This Greek Hermes Helmet Package can be used in a variety of programs. I’ve included the file formats:

  - 3DS

  - DFX

  - OBJ (medium, high)

  - FBX 

  - MAX

  - STL

  - ZTL 

  - C4D

  - 3D COATThe package offers textures and two obj files. The mesh comes in high and medium polygon options to fit your needs. The 3DS Max version and the Cinema 4D version allow for mesh smoothing. Textures are included in 2048x2048 for clear resolution. The package includes the following maps:

  - Diffuse

  - Normal

  - Fresnel

  - Reflectance

  - RoughnessThe package is presented in zip format. This requires an unzipping tool which most computers have as standard application. Use the appropriate format into your favorite 3D modeling program and customize the textures. The Greek Hermes Helmet Package models come pre-UV mapped along with a handy bitmap template from which to layout your own textures. Feel free to drop your suggestions to me for both realistic and fantasy style headgear.Be sure to check out the other models in my gallery. I’m always adding more models, so check back regularly; just click on my user name.

description_text:
3d model Dragon warriorSculpt in ZBrush
ZBrush is a 3D modeling software created by Pixologic. A distinctive feature of this software is the imitation of the process of “sculpting” a three-dimensional sculpture, reinforced by a three-dimensional rendering engine in real time, which greatly simplifies the process of creating the desired three-dimensional object. Each point (called a pixel) contains information not only about its XY coordinates and color values, but also its depth Z, orientation and material. This means that you can not only “sculpt” a three-dimensional object, but also “colorize” it by drawing strokes with depth. But you don’t have to draw shadows and highlights to make them look natural - ZBrush will do this automatically.

description_text:
Frankenstein's monster or Frankenstein's creature, often incorrectly referred to as simply Frankenstein, is a fictional character who first appeared in Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus. Shelley's title thus compares the monster's creator, Victor Frankenstein, to the mythological character Prometheus, who fashioned humans out of clay and gave them fire.
Shelley described Frankenstein's monster as an 8-foot-tall, hideously ugly creation, with translucent yellowish skin pulled so taut over the body that it “barely disguised the workings of the arteries and muscles underneath,” watery, glowing eyes, flowing black hair, black lips, and prominent white teeth.

description_text:
This Elf Hat Package is based on the traditional Santa hat seen at Christmas time. The hat is perfect for men and women.  This asset is perfect for holiday theme characters or 3D printing enthusiasts.Our Elf  Hat Package  is fully customizable. The template included in the package allows you to add your own custom color options. It was designed for a standard height figures (186 cm) in Cinema 4D and Zbrush. This package is ideal for game assets, illustration and animation. It’s sized for standard figures in Unity, Poser or Daz Studio. I’ve broken the model down into its basic components for ease of customization. This Elf  Hat Package  can be used in a variety of programs. I’ve included the file formats:

  - 3DS

  - BLN

  - DFX

  - OBJ (medium, high)

  - FBX 

  - MAX

  - SUB

  - STL

  - ZTL 

  - C4D

  - 3D COATThe package offers textures and two obj files. The mesh comes in high and medium polygon options to fit your needs. The Blender version and the Cinema 4D version allow for mesh smoothing. Textures are included in 2048x2048 for clear resolution. The package includes the following maps:

  - Diffuse

  - Normal

  - Fresnel

  - Reflectance

  - RoughnessThe package is presented in zip format. This requires an unzipping tool which most computers have as standard application. Use the appropriate format into your favorite 3D modeling program and customize the textures. The TEX folder contains the textures that come with these models.The Elf  Hat Package  models come pre-UV mapped along with a handy bitmap template from which to layout your own textures. Feel free to drop your suggestions to me for both realistic and fantasy style headgear.Be sure to check out the other models in my gallery. I’m always adding more models, so check back regularly; just click on my user name.

description_text:
Rough but elegant, this helm is adorned with chainmail to keep your neck safe and stylish.
For the material, I suggest just a simple metallic shader with your favorite roughness texture plugged in as the bump map. At least that's what I did in the renders pictured. No doubt you can come up with something better, and all the pieces are unwrapped, so you can just plug your textures right in. Don't have a texture, you say? Well, everything I used is backed into the attached .blend, so you can just grab it from there!
About that rigging: The chainmail links a hooked up to strips of cloth via a myriad of empties. If you put a collision object under the rig or shake the helmet around, the chainmail should react. Of course, this will only work in the helmet's native blender, and I also removed the empties from all the file exports, but if you want them back in to recreate the effect in your favorite software, just let me or grab it from the .blend. And if you can't get the physics working, let me know. I'm around. I can help you out.

description_text:
- 
Style: Skulls with Cracked Earth

  - 
Size: 60mm x 32mm 

  - 
Shape: Oval

  - 
Number: 5

Legendgames Skull Bases come in a variety of designs, from full-skull models to open terrain with a few scattered skulls and long bones.Our base is usually a cracked earth surface with scattered rocks and stones intermingled with skulls and long bones.Some of our bases might feature shifting sands, bubbling mud or rocks and crystals, but in general they all have a consistent look and feel to give your armies a uniform look.Our bases feature a selection of skulls and bones, not just multiples of the same item. A lot of thought goes into positioning and aesthetics - these are not cheap cookie-cutter bases, these are top notch!
Our smaller bases are ideal for small monsters and single combat figures, with bases designed for good foot location for fixing your figure. Our medium bases are designed for cavalry units and mid sized monsters and warriors, but they can accommodate a small multi figure unit too. Some are the right size for flying creatures too.We have some larger bases designed specifically for flying monsters, large mechs, multi-figure units or giant monsters.Our massive bases are ideal for those big bad bosses - Dragons, Mechs, Mechanised units or big flyers.You don't have to use these for game play - our medium and larger bases make a great starting point for diorama or trophy figures.
Whilst these bases are designed with specific games in mind, most notably Warhammer 40k and Age of Sigmar, they are of course compatible with any ttrpg or skirmish game that uses the relevant base size - and if your game uses a marginally different size then scaling up or down a few mm should not be an issue. Just don't go too far of the skulls will look a bit out-of-scale. Skulls and bones are, of course, a staple of near future post-apocalyptic and dystopian settings. Our bases cater for these games as well as more mainline wargames and other niche needs from gothic to fantasy and anywhere in between.
So whether you are basing your mainstream WH Space Marines, Khorne, Battle Sisters and Space Wolves or using them for more niche games such as Scrappers,  basing your Wasteland survivors or making cool bases for the Big Boss and his minions in your Dungeons and Dragons game , we've got something for everyone.
Get a better deal:
These bases are also available in our 'complete skull base collection' along with ALL our other skull bases.  It’s a great purchase because once it’s been bought, you will get new releases without further charge.

description_text:
Hello!This is my goblin fantasy character that I used for my course in Unity. Please feel free and have a look at the Vimeo preview to see if it's something for you. :) If you use my mdl, please TAG ME/send me a message on instagram (jMoltkeArt), I would love to see what you come up with! 
Software: Maya 2020.2 
Game ready asset - works fine in Unity. 
MESH:Low-poly 3D character mesh. UV-wrapped.Rigged with mixamo. Mesh is quad-based. Polycount: 5010 quads - 10020 tris (with shield and sword (podium not included)).
TEX:Textures included are:
Base Color (col): 4k, 2k & 1kRoughness (specR): 4k, 2k & 1kBump map (bump): 4k, 2k & 1k
Plug and play, it's 1 UDIM tile. :) 
Base Color can be used by itself (like in preview). 
RIG:Character has a modifed Mixamo rig (updated skin weights & sword/shield controls, scale constraints, ect.) with some exported baked joint animations from Mixamo. 
Please note: Mixamo rig is a relatively limited rigging-option, but quick solution for a character rig. Some parts on the character does not have controls, like the hanging cloth, ect. :) If you wanna rig it well yourself - Feel free, and please let me know how it goes. Rig is only in Maya Ascii 2020.2
Rig has both FK and IK controls on both legs/both arms and an Options (S) control that toggles invisibility on geometry and joints. If you wonder why you cannot click on mesh/joints - Just change the drawing overrides from reference to normal. :) 
FEEDBACK:Please let me know if you think something needs improvement. :) Enjoy my character model! 
Cheers,~ jMoltkeArt

description_text: The Flying Flea (Pou du Ciel literally Louse of the Sky in French) is a large family of light homebuilt aircraft first flown in 1933. The odd name comes from the French nickname for the Ford Model T automobile, Pou de la Route or Louse of the Road because Henry Ford's economy car was so common and initially came only in black. Henri Mignet dreamed of creating a Model T of the air, an airplane for the common man, hence Pou du Ciel. In the English translation, the term became Flying Flea. Originally applied only to the HM.14 model, the name has now come to describe the family of aircraft of similar configuration designed by Mignet and others (Source Wikipedia)

description_text:
The Apollo Belvedere or Apollo of the Belvedere — also called the Pythian Apollo— is a celebrated marble sculpture from Classical Antiquity.It was rediscovered in central Italy in the late 15th century, during the Renaissance. From the mid-18th century it was considered the greatest ancient sculpture by ardent neoclassicists, and for centuries epitomized ideals of aesthetic perfection for Europeans and westernized parts of the world. It is now found in the Cortile delle Statue of the Pio-Clementine Museum of the Vatican Museums complex.
Apollo Belvedere bust sculpture is a digital detailed high polygon 3D model. This 3d model was created by ZBrush 4R8 and exported to STL and OBJ formats.
This 3d model is prepared to physical production by 3d printing, CNC machining and for making a mold for casting in gypsum, plastic, metal, chocolate etc. Also it can be used for interiour design and vizualizations.
The original size of digital sculpture is 142x200x88 mm. 3d model can be scaled up or down.

description_text:
The STEN (or Sten gun) was a family of British submachine guns chambered in 9×19mm and used extensively by British and Commonwealth forces throughout World War II and the Korean War. They were notable for having a simple design and very low production cost, and so also making them effective insurgency weapons for resistance groups. STEN is an acronym, from the names of the weapon's chief designers, Major Reginald V. Shepherd and Harold Turpin, and EN for Enfield. Over four million Stens in various versions were made in the 1940s.The Sten used simple stamped metal components and minor welding, which required minimal machining and manufacturing. Much of the production could be performed by small workshops, with the firearms assembled at the Enfield site. Over the period of manufacture the Sten design was further simplified: the most basic model, the Mark III, could be produced from five man-hours of work. Some of the cheapest versions were made from only 47 different parts. It was distinctive for its bare appearance (just a pipe with a metal loop for a stock), and its horizontal magazine.(Source: Wikipedia)
Sten MK2 gun comes with Vray setup, you just need to add hdri map to vray light.

description_text:
A sculpture/bust of a man, who is apparently very important (it's not of your next-door neighbor), with ancient roman undertones. Perfect for your home, office, gallery, art studio, government (or academia) building, or villainous lair. Comes with marble, gold, and iron textures, as well as 2 LODs (level of detail).
Designed to be a handsome piece (aside from the subject matter), from a plaster mold, with medieval or ancient roman undertones, that will add an image of wealth to any room. This is a bust of Ruperticus the Great, Emperor of Rupertania, who was known for being a champion of the new entrepreneurship class, and originator of family fun. He used his great wealth to help the poor, create the first entrepreneurial class in a previously fragmented society, and for coming up with games for families to enjoy together (we won't talk about his other proclivities). An excellent piece for government or academic offices/buildings, commercial interiors, office spaces, homes, museums, etc. You might not be able to park your Ferrari in your living room, but you can have a bust that indicates your wealth, and appreciation for fun. Made to look either like hand-carved marble, cast iron, or gold overlay.
This asset is part of Burnout Game Studio’s “RAK 2: Picture Perfect” collection. BGS provides aspiring, as well as seasoned, game & VR devs with the experience they want, to get their dream industry job. An in-house development studio for Burnout Game Ventures, Roadside Assistance Kits (RAKs) are carefully curated asset packs, aimed at specific target markets.

description_text: Scary Pumpkins are just what you need this halloween. Add it to your scene to give a little spooky flare or give that headless horseman something to rest on his shoulders. Just like a real carved pumpkin, the top can be removed revealing a hole to place in a candle. The sample pictures are an example of how the pumpkin will look in a spooky scene and does not imply that the haunted house is included in this download.People have been making jack-o’-lanterns at Halloween for centuries. The practice originated from an Irish myth about a man nicknamed “Stingy Jack.” According to the story, Stingy Jack invited the Devil to have a drink with him. True to his name, Stingy Jack didn’t want to pay for his drink, so he convinced the Devil to turn himself into a coin that Jack could use to buy their drinks. Once the Devil did so, Jack decided to keep the money and put it into his pocket next to a silver cross, which prevented the Devil from changing back into his original form. Jack eventually freed the Devil, under the condition that he would not bother Jack for one year and that, should Jack die, he would not claim his soul. The next year, Jack again tricked the Devil into climbing into a tree to pick a piece of fruit. While he was up in the tree, Jack carved a sign of the cross into the tree’s bark so that the Devil could not come down until the Devil promised Jack not to bother him for ten more years.

Sincerely Yours,
Svetlana

Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 13910 vertices, 13908 quad faces (27816 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!* Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha, normal);* Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);* Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);* Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);* generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)* generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just drag-and-drop the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!
IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
The santur is a hammered dulcimer of Persian/Iranic origins. The term Santur originally meant 100 strings.
Versions of the santur or hammered dulcimer are used throughout the world. In Eastern Europe, a larger descendant of the hammered dulcimer called the cimbalom is played and has been used by a number of classical composers, including Zoltán Kodály, Igor Stravinsky and Pierre Boulez, and more recently, in a different musical context, by Blue Man Group. The khim is the name of both the Thai and the Khmer hammered dulcimer. The Chinese yangqin is a type of hammered dulcimer that originated in Persia. The santur and santoor are found in the Middle East and India, respectively.

A little mosquito spying you, or your enemies! This spy robot is inspired to the generical idea of flying spy robot we often see in movies and cartoons. I picked a minimalistic design, with fewer polygons, and a hybrid style between a fly, a mosquito and a drone. Finally completed this Goku sculpt, It is a posable 3D model with seperate elements for arms, legs, head etc.
Checkout the different designs in my collection from simple cute designs to scary organic sculpts. 
Take note to double check and resize accordingly before 3D printing.I have included many files of different level of details for your convenience. Refer to filename for Poly Count (K=thousands of Triangle polygons).
These are Oculus Home ready models, just copy the .GLB files, which are just binary versions of the new glTR file format into your “oculus home ->  _import” folder. 
Most of my work is sculpted directly in Oculus Medium VR.Most objects are separate elements which means you can mix and match to achieve the effect you want.
The photos and videos are created directly in the Medium VR 3D engine.I definitely had fun creating this project from within VR. 
If you enjoy what you see then give a like or comment to support more of this effort.

description_text: Iron Fist (Daniel Danny Rand) is a fictional character, a superhero who appears in comics published by Marvel Comics. Created by Roy Thomas and Gil Kane, Iron Fist first appeared in Marvel Premiere # 15 (May 1974). The character is a practitioner of martial arts and the possessor of a mystical force known as the Iron Fist, which allows him to invoke and focus his chi. He starred in his own solo series in the 1970s, and shared the title Power Man and Iron Fist for several years with Luke Cage, teaming up with Cage to form the superhero team Heroes for Hire. The character has starred in numerous solo titles since, including The Immortal Iron Fist, which expanded on his origin story and the story of the Iron Fist.  Marvel's Iron Fist, or simply Iron Fist, is an American television series created by Netflix and Scott Buck and based on the character of the same name from the Marvel comics. The series is located in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (UCM), sharing continuity with the films of the franchise, and being the fourth origin series that leads to the special Los Defenders. The series is produced by Marvel Television in association with ABC Studios alongside Buck as showrunner for the series.

description_text: A fully rigged alien/wendigo character model. It is animation ready and can be used for VFX or animation. It is easy to animate with a simple weight painted bone structure. It has a multries modifyer on it so you can animate with low poly and have it high detailed in the render. The wendigo was sculpted, retopologiesed, textured, added hair, rigged it and is ready for animation. I made an account specifically for this model as I think it is to a good standard. For the texture it was UV unwrapped and then texture painted. I am using it for my own short film but I thought it would be good to sell it so you dont have to do the long task of making a charcter from scratch yourself as it takes a very long time. The bones are relativly simple with Inverse kinematics that have been weight painted. At 124 samples the wendigo itself can render around 20 seconds in most circumstances. The model has sub surface scattering in order to add to the realism in renders, works really well with a HDRI. the animations I made for the preview aren't great as I am not much of an animator but in the hands of someone with more animation experience it  would turn out really well I think.

description_text:
Inspired by the title of the movie Space Cowboys.Not what I expected but gave me an idea: changing an old leathery cowboy's hat into something more futuristic.The original old cowboy hat is also included.To change the color of the hat with the stars change the hue & saturation value. For the outline, it has a separate Light material included which also can be easily changed.
Rather than old leather and a belt, the Space Cowboy hat has synthetic materials, vents, lights, and outer rim lights. Eventually I'd like to make some space cowboys, and do the same to those wild west buildings. So this is a start to a unique collection. Now available in USDZ and GITF.
The original old hat has 2541 verticies and 2496 polygons.It's all been done with the substance painter, and Blender. Ive been using normal maps combined with real geometry. The png files for the hats are in a folder, SC Hat Textures, the old one's inTextures".

description_text:
The lost tree is a game environment created in 3ds max 2010 and rendered with the default scanline renderer. My game environment includes: fortress walls, fortress gate, huge rocks, the cliff, an ocean, a dome, 4 towers, a building with 2 levels with spiral staircases, exterior stairs, coffins, statues, a pond and the lost tree.

  - optimised polygon count (17796 polys, 24912 verts) 

  - clean geometry

  - all objects in the scene are unwrapped

  - textures are created in photoshop and includes diffuse, specular and normal maps at 2048x2048 each in jpg and tga formats.

  - 45 total maps: 40 maps applyed to fortress and it's elements, 4 textures applyed to the cliff and the ocean (procedural maps) and a sky hdr map applyed to the dome

  - alpha channel available for the tree leaves and spider webs.

  - atmospheric effects used: fog, fire, glow

  - to illuminate the interior i used omni lights to simulate fire  and ambiental light; and for the exterior i used daylight combined with an omni light.

  - 2 animations included: one is a walkthrough in the scene from the point of view of a character (500 frames) and the second one is a turntable around the fortress (36 frames).

  - water and the atmospheric effects are animated

  - i used a different material for the ocean in the animation

  - my reference was only my imagination

Don't forget to check out other character and related models by clicking on my name. Thanks.

description_text:
This low-poly 3D model is based on an old sci-fi concept art and was made primarily for game development. This model was modeled, UV unwrapped, and rendered in blender, but textured in substance painter. The model has no animations and does not come with accessories (like a sheath), what you see in the presentation images is what you will be receiving.
It says updated in the title because this is an updated version of the futuristic scifi blade I posted months earlier, in that model there was no texture, the concept art itself was the texture that was used for the render images, as the model was UV projected from the front view to fit the concept art and coat it as a texture. 
Below are all the maps/textures that come with the model. All textures are in 4K dimensions.
SciFiBlade_BaseColor.png (4096x4096) SciFiBlade_Metallic.png (4096x4096) SciFiBlade_Normal.png (4096x4096)SciFiBlade_Roughness.png (4096x4096) SciFiBladeCombinedTexture.png (4096x4096) - This image is a combined image that was used in the render images.

description_text:
Trinity era una hacker dentro de Matrix hasta que fue despertada por Morfeo, tras lo cual se une al bando rebelde en la lucha contra las máquinas. Colabora en la misión de despertar a Neo, con quien inicia una relación sentimental poco tiempo después. Se desvela que es una habilidosa hacker, al conseguir piratear la Hacienda estadounidense, sorprendiendo a Neo que el hacker resultara ser una mujer.
Trinity opera con Neo en el rescate de Morfeo y trata de asistirle en su batalla contra el Agente Smith. Cuando Neo es abatido por este, Trinity le confiesa su amor, declarando que el Oráculo predijo que se enamoraría del «Elegido».
En Matrix Reloaded Neo y Trinity mantienen una relación. Neo está afectado, debido a que padece pesadillas recurrentes donde observa su muerte. Trinity participa junto a Neo y Morfeo en la búsqueda de Merovingio y del Fabricante de Llaves. Después, escapa junto a Morfeo de una persecución a manos de los Gemelos, guardaespaldas de Merovingio.
Mientras Neo intenta contactar con el Arquitecto, Trinity acude a rescatarlo. Se infiltra en el edificio, enfrentándose a dos agentes. Neo descubre entonces que debe escoger, entre la salvación de Zion, o la de Trinity, decantándose por esta segunda opción. Mientras Trinity cae desde la cristalera de un edificio, justo como en sus pesadillas, Neo logra salvarla de caer al vacío. Tras eso, les confiesa a todos que no es el Elegido.

description_text: This is ruby ring. It can be used for 3D printing, games or movies. You can contact me if you want custom ring. A ring is a round band, usually of metal, worn as ornamental jewellery. The term ring by itself always denotes jewellery worn on the finger; when worn as an ornament elsewhere, the body part is specified within the term, e.g., earrings, neck rings, arm rings, and toe rings. Rings always fit snugly around or in the part of the body they ornament, so bands worn loosely, like a bracelet, are not rings. Rings may be made of almost any hard material: wood, bone, stone, metal, glass, gemstone or plastic. They may be set with gemstones (diamond, ruby, sapphire or emerald) or with other types of stone or glass.

description_text:
This is a high polygon spider looking robot. It was inspired by thewandering on CGcookie's instagram page. Made in Blender and rendered with Cycles render engine.
The main part of it was made with a cylinder and multiple loop cuts, bevels and booleans. Details were made with bevelled cubes with added boolean modifiers. Bolts were made from hexagonal cylinders. 
For the arm pieces, I used a curve to connect the bottom parts and make it look more organic. After that, I used two cylinders and added edge loops and booleans to give them more detail.  For the hooks, I used cubes with a subdivision surface modifier. 
Materials were used for this model, no textures were used. Materials: plastic (yellow and black), silver (light and dark).
Made to what would be real-world scale if these actually existed. Best used in sci fi scenes.
Native: blend; Other formats: obj, fbx, stl, ply

Dear customer,
“The beauty of the nation” is a series of models of heads.
The model is made in the scale 1/35, it is ready for use in dioramas of the 35th scale. The detailing of the model is appropriate - the details are clearer and larger, which is typical for miniature objects.

The project “The Beauty of the Nation” is based on the idea of showing the public that every nation, every race and every ethnic group has its own beauty and its own zest, which can be admired and inspired. We idolize beauty and extol it in all sources of realization available to us: be it a sculpture, a painting, poetry, music or cinema. Beauty, in spite of the differences in cultures and the views of the majority, proved that the boundaries, opinions and customs are alien to it. Beauty is an inspiration for contemplation, which entails the creation of even more beautiful things.
Sincerely Yours,
Svetlana

description_text:
This is a realistic 3D model of a fridge magnet souvenir. It is meant for either rendering or 3d printing.

  - Model is scaled to real world scale in metric units, and is placed very near / above the ground.

  - Mesh is unique (only one object), 100% quads and completely watertight.

  - STL file has 6 level iteration subdivision and displacement already applied, so the polygon and vertices number is completely different. It is ready for 3d print.

  - Two OBJ Files with different subdivision levels: one with no subdivisions or displacement applied, the other with 6 iterations and displacement applied.

  - The model has diffuse, normal, specular and displacement maps. All 4096x4096 in resolution. When rendering, the normal map should only be used if the displacement map is not used. Otherwise, the results might not be as good.

  - All textures are in PNG format.

  - Redshift, Corona, V-Ray, Arnold and Default materials included for 3ds Max. V-Ray materials for Cinema4D. Default standard materials for Blender, OBJ and FBX version.

  - No isolated vertices, no overlapping vertices or faces, no missing textures.

Renders were done in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
The rendering scenes are not included.

description_text:
This is a realistic 3D model of a fridge magnet souvenir. It is meant for either rendering or 3d printing.

  - Model is scaled to real world scale in metric units, and is placed very near / above the ground.

  - Mesh is unique (only one object), 100% quads and completely watertight.

  - STL file has 6 level iteration subdivision and displacement already applied, so the polygon and vertices number is completely different. It is ready for 3d print.

  - Two OBJ Files with different subdivision levels: one with no subdivisions or displacement applied, the other with 6 iterations and displacement applied.

  - The model has diffuse, normal, specular and displacement maps. All 4096x4096 in resolution. When rendering, the normal map should only be used if the displacement map is not used. Otherwise, the results might not be as good.

  - All textures are in PNG format.

  - Redshift, Corona, V-Ray, Arnold and Default materials included for 3ds Max. V-Ray materials for Cinema4D. Default standard materials for Blender, OBJ and FBX version.

  - No isolated vertices, no overlapping vertices or faces, no missing textures.

Renders were done in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
The rendering scenes are not included.

description_text:
This is a realistic 3D model of a fridge magnet souvenir. It is meant for either rendering or 3d printing.

  - Model is scaled to real world scale in metric units, and is placed very near / above the ground.

  - Mesh is unique (only one object), 100% quads and completely watertight.

  - STL file has 6 level iteration subdivision and displacement already applied, so the polygon and vertices number is completely different. It is ready for 3d print.

  - Two OBJ Files with different subdivision levels: one with no subdivisions or displacement applied, the other with 6 iterations and displacement applied.

  - The model has diffuse, normal, specular and displacement maps. All 4096x4096 in resolution. When rendering, the normal map should only be used if the displacement map is not used. Otherwise, the results might not be as good.

  - All textures are in PNG format.

  - Redshift, Corona, V-Ray, Arnold and Default materials included for 3ds Max. V-Ray materials for Cinema4D. Default standard materials for Blender, OBJ and FBX version.

  - No isolated vertices, no overlapping vertices or faces, no missing textures.

Renders were done in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
The rendering scenes are not included.

description_text:
Create your own super light scalemail with 3d printing.
Scales perfectly aligned to be able to print several and generate a pattern of scales.You can create whatever you want, bracers, shields, armor, etc.You just need to print several of these scales individually and then stick them to a surface.

Ancient Egyptian deities are the gods and goddesses worshipped in ancient Egypt. The beliefs and rituals surrounding these gods formed the core of ancient Egyptian religion, which emerged sometime in prehistory. Deities represented natural forces and phenomena, and the Egyptians supported and appeased them through offerings and rituals so that these forces would continue to function according to maat, or divine order. After the founding of the Egyptian state around 3100 BC, the authority to perform these tasks was controlled by the pharaoh, who claimed to be the gods' representative and managed the temples where the rituals were carried out.
The gods' complex characteristics were expressed in myths and in intricate relationships between deities: family ties, loose groups and hierarchies, and combinations of separate gods into one. Deities' diverse appearances in art—as animals, humans, objects, and combinations of different forms—also alluded, through symbolism, to their essential features.

description_text:
Pop-it is one of the top toys of 2021, which is already being compared to spinners in popularity. The phenomenon could pass by many in runet, as the culture was born and developed purely in tiktok, where videos with anti-stress accoutrements have billions of views. TJ explains what pop-its are, and why they have a lot in common with the usual soothing activity - squeezing the bubbles from the packages.
After purchasing this model you get:

  - Files in obj, fbx, max and mtl formats;

  - High-quality Pop It Rainbow Rubber Baby Toy model;

  - My support for all possible questions related to this model;

If you have any problems that you can't solve on your own, be sure to email me! Together we will solve any of your problems!
Additional information about Pop It:
Pop-it literally translates to burst it. It's a children's game that can be compared to popping bubblegum wrapping film. But while in the latter case each bubble wrap is disposable, pop-its can be squeezed with characteristic sensations and sounds indefinitely: dozens of silicone bubbles are simply squeezed out the other way.
Judging by the instructions on the packages of pop-its, there are several playful scenarios. It helps in the development of fine motor skills and concentration, so the toy is used to develop sensory integration, among other things. But mostly pop-its are bought for the anti-stress effect, and not just for children.
Pop-its come in many shapes, sizes and colors. It's hard to say who developed the toy and when. On YouTube you can find reviews of the toy from 2019, but it probably did not have such popularity then.
The popularity of these toys is a credit to tiktok. The videos with the hashtag #popit already have 2.5 billion views, while #popits and #popitasmr have 176 million and 45 million views, respectively. In thousands of videos, users show the toy, praising its anti-stress qualities and even telling how to make a similar one with their own hands. In Russia, pop-its are also popular - 120 million views for the tag #popit . Videos about Simple Dimple also have tens of millions of views.

description_text:
Fantasy Football, is a tabletop game where two teams play an american football game against each other. The game is took in a fantasy world, home of legendary creatures like orcs, dwarves, elves, goblins etc.
Usually, 28-32mm miniatures are used for this game, representing players on the field. Goal of the game is the touchdown, who makes the most wins!
The game is played on a boxed playground.
Main rule is: no-hold-barred, in fact players can try to wound and mutilate opponents to get an easier touchdown by reducing the number of opponents.
Crosslances propose his own team, completely in digital, for 3D printing.
In our team you'll find crooked, genetically modified abominations, perfect to be played as Goblins or Putrids in a Fantasy football game.
From tentacles to tails, pustules to scars, in this team nothing is held back to instill fear in your opponent! They are as bad as they are ugly!
Miniatures are sculpted in ZBrush to obtain high quality details.

description_text:
Fantasy Football, is a tabletop game where two teams play an american football game against each other. The game is took in a fantasy world, home of legendary creatures like orcs, dwarves, elves, goblins etc.
Usually, 28-32mm miniatures are used for this game, representing players on the field. Goal of the game is the touchdown, who makes the most wins!
The game is played on a boxed playground.
Main rule is: no-hold-barred, in fact players can try to wound and mutilate opponents to get an easier touchdown by reducing the number of opponents.
Crosslances propose his own team, completely in digital, for 3D printing.
In our team you'll find crooked, genetically modified abominations, perfect to be played as Goblins or Putrids in a Fantasy football game.
From tentacles to tails, pustules to scars, in this team nothing is held back to instill fear in your opponent! They are as bad as they are ugly!
Miniatures are sculpted in ZBrush to obtain high quality details.

description_text:
Novel Coronavirus COVID-19 anatomical structure, ready for use in low-polygon and subdivision CGI applications. Modeled in Carrara Studio and provided in multiple file formats (OBJ, FBX, 3DS, CAR, and STL). Great for low-detail anatomical illustrations of both internal and external virus structures. Anatomical structures included are the envelope, nueraminidase, hemagglutinin, and RNA.
Low-polygon base mesh is created with all-quad construction, ready for subdivision.
Also included are 5 high-resolution renders of both the complete and sectioned (cutaway) virus models. Renders are 4,000 x 3,000 px and are provided in BMP, JPG, and PNG formats. Renders are provided with 3 background colors - black, white, and transparent (PNG format only).
Includes 2 model representations:

  - Complete Coronavirus model showing external anatomical features only

  - Sectioned (cutaway) Coronavirus model showing both internal and external anatomical features

Each representation is provided in 2 levels of detail:

  - Base mesh with all-quad construction

  - Subdivision level 1

Models can be subdivided further if additional resolution is required.
Complete Coronavirus model specifications:

  - Objects: 3

  - Facets (base mesh): 6,384

  - Facets (subdivision level 1): 25,536

  - Shaders: 3

Sectioned (cutaway) Coronavirus model specifications:

  - Objects: 4

  - Facets (base mesh): 8,968

  - Facets (subdivision level 1): 35,872

  - Shaders: 4

Note: Turbulence bump maps are available in the Carrara Studio (CAR format) version only. Screenshots of the bump map settings are provided to help you recreate these effects in your 3D software of choice.
Product includes:

  - 4 OBJ models with external materials - complete and sectioned (cutaway) models, base mesh and subdivision level 1

  - 4 FBX models - complete and sectioned (cutaway) models, base mesh and subdivision level 1

  - 4 3DS models - complete and sectioned (cutaway) models, base mesh and subdivision level 1

  - 1 Carrara scene (CAR format) - includes complete and sectioned (cutaway) models, base mesh and subdivision level 1, cameras, and lights

  - 4 STL models - complete and sectioned (cutaway) models, base mesh and subdivision level 1

  - 5 High-resolution renders (BMP, JPG, and PNG formats)

  - 4 Bump map screenshots (BMP and JPG formats)

If you have any questions, either before or after purchasing this model, please feel free to contact me here on CGTrader and I will help in any way possible.

description_text:
This is a two part platypus USB-Stick case for an Intenso Slim Line USB 3.0 stick. The cap is pressed into the hole in the body, and the actual usb-stick is encased in the beak of the platypus. Below the tail is a hole for a string for a e.g. a keychain. The design is quite robust, though not made for extremely tuff environments. The size of the platypus is LxWxH - 85x25x16,5 [mm] maximum. When I originally designed it, I didn't anticipate to once upload it, so I only have quite bad quality pictures out of videos I had roughly taken during prototyping.
To assemble, I recommend to first press in the parts of the USB-Stick in their corresponding halves. This can be quite hard by hand, so I used a small vice to apply pressure evenly. If it doesn't fit, you may enlarge the holes with a file, or heat them up with a hot air gun. If it's too lose, use a drop of glue to ensure the stick not falling out. Furthermore, the stick sticks out far enough to be normaly usable and does not interfere with the usability of it.
As a paint, I used acrylic colours that I spread as evenly as possible not with a brush, but an old check card to apply a thick coating, pushing it into the nooks and crannies. For the eyes, I used a white-out pen with an Edding (=German Sharpie). Be careful, not to get any paint into the USB-Stick!
Feel free to use different colour scemes!
If there are any questions, feel free to contact me.

description_text:
Collection of four dinosaur light switch cover plates (Tyrannosaurus, Triceratops, Apatosaurus, and Stegosaurus), ready for 3D print. Modeled in Autodesk Inventor and provided in multiple file formats.
Have a dinosaur fan in your family? Light up their room with this 3D-printable collection of dinosaur-themed wall decor. Fits standard-sized light switches (United States and other imperial regions).
Want to customize your cover plates? Native Autodesk Inventor 2012 files feature editable text so that you can include your child's name.
All cover plates are provided in three configurations - blank / no text (all formats), dinosaur name displayed (all formats), and editable text (native Autodesk Inventor 2012 files only).
Please note that this product includes the dinosaur cover plates only. Wall and light switch are shown for illustration purposes only.
Collection includes:
Tyrannosaurus light switch cover plate:
  - Physical dimensions: 3.19 x 7.27 x 0.25 in
Triceratops light switch cover plate:
  - Physical dimensions: 3.71 x 7.19 x 0.25 in
Apatosaurus light switch cover plate:
  - Physical dimensions: 3.15 x 7.14 x 0.25 in
Stegosaurus light switch cover plate:
  - Physical dimensions: 3.89 x 6.96 x 0.25 in
Product includes:

  - 12 Autodesk Inventor 2012 models (IPT format) - all 4 dinosaurs in 3 configurations (blank / no text, dinosaur name displayed, and editable text)

  - 8 STP models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 8 SAT models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 8 IGS models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 8 STL models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 8 OBJ models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 4 PDF drawings - all 4 dinosaurs

  - 1 Read Me text file (TXT format)

If you have any questions, either before or after purchasing this model collection, please feel free to contact me here on CGTrader and I will help in any way possible.
CBSpicer

description_text:
The art-deco sculpture depicts a beautiful young woman in a long fitting dress and with a theatrical headdress representing a constellation of stars. The figure raised on an integral plinth.
​The figure is based on the magnificent work of Jepe, clearly inspired by the remarkable work of Erté. Erté (Roman Petrovich Tyrtov) (1892 - 1990), a famous artist and designer of the 20th century. He has contributed to many areas, including fashion, jewelry, graphics, costume design and scenery for cinema, theater and opera, as well as interior design. Many of Erte's works are currently on display at museums such as the New York Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Smithsonian Institution.
​The Startrek statuette in 1/7 scale (363 mm) now adorns the shelf in my living room, and the 1/18 scale (123 mm) figurine revives my car collection.
Reference: https://3dladnik.wixsite.com/workshop/starstruck?lang=en
The original model was refined in ZBrush for a good 3D printing on a small and large scale. ​For printing on a large scale made version divided into two parts by the height of the figurine. To connect the parts with each other and with the stand, channels are provided for the installation of pins.
I printed this model on an FDM printer Lad-1.0 (https://3dladnik.wixsite.com/portfolio/lad-1-0-en) on a scale of 1/7 and 1/10 (0.3 mm nozzle and 0.1 mm layer) and on a 1/18 scale (0.2 mm nozzle and layer 0.06 mm). This sculpture will look great on a scale of 1/7 (height 363 mm) and more.

description_text:
This sculpture shows the moment of classical ballet. A moment of dance and a graceful gesture of the ballerina’s hands emphasize the beauty, the composition is complemented by a stand painted under a decorative stone. Performed in a realistic style, with a lot of small details, the sculpture demonstrates mastery and can decorate any interior.
References: https://3dladnik.wixsite.com/workshop/ballerina4?lang=en
Sculpture height: 260 mm.
Plastic Consumption:Figurine (assembled from three parts and a fan) - 80 gramsPedestal - 37 grams
This sculpture was printed on an FDM printer Lad-1.0 with a nozzle of 0.4 mm, a layer height of 0.1 mm when printing the Figurine and 0.2 mm when printing the Pedestal.
Post-processing: grinding, chemical polishing with ethyl acetate.Coloring: acrylic enamels and polyurethane varnish. It was painted with a brush.
To reduce the consumption of plastic for printing supports, you can print the upper and lower parts of the Figurine separately, in the optimal orientation for printing on an FDM printer (files Ballerina4-top.stl and Ballerina4-bottom.stl).The fan is printed separately and attached to the Figurine using a curved pin of steel wire with a diameter of 0.5 mm. (There are two fan options: the Ballerina4-Fan.stl fan itself and the fan with the built-in Ballerina4-FanSup.stl supports, which must be removed after printing).
The Figurine and the Pedestal are connected using a curved pin with a diameter of 1 mm.

description_text:
ZBrush default subdivisions will smooth out your mesh (which led to detail loss), and shrink your mesh (especialy at the edge) so your low-res and hi-res mesh won't match.This macro will let you subdivide your ZBrush mesh the alternative way which will reduce shrinkage and preserve details of your mesh.It is good for organic meshes such as humanoid and creatures (soft edges), and will produce artifacts if used on hard-surface meshes. Use with caution.
CHANGELOG:v1.1: Update to a faster script.v1.2: Got rid of unnecessary undo history. No more multiple undo steps.
CONTENTS:
This package contains one macro script for ZBrush.
INSTALLATION:

  - Extract & copy Poligone folder inside .ZIP file to ZStartup\Macros folder inside ZBrush installation path (Default at C:\Program Files\Pixologic\ZBrush\ZStartup\Macros).

  - Restart ZBrush.

USAGE:Under Macros menu (on top of ZBrush main interface) you will find NDSub buttons
COMPATIBLE:ZBrush 2018 and above (Tested working on 2021.1)

description_text:
Hello everyone!
Today I present a 3D model of the male foot that was sculpted in Blender. The low-poly version consists of around 22 000 vertices but also the high-poly version is included. Model was first sculpted, than was decimated to reduce the number of vertices. The high-poly version was baked into the normal map of the low-poly model.  The low-poly model is unwrapped and textured with 4 sets of textures: realistic skin, damaged flesh, old iron and polished marble. All the textures are 4k and include base color, roughness, AO, normal, Height, Metallic. The .obj files of the model in both versions (high- and low-poly) are included if anyone want to add additional details to the model. Those formats are easily importable to any 3D software.Textures are packed within the blend file and additionally, the archive file with all the textures is included.
The model is great as an individual or the mesh thac can be connected with your own human models!
For personal request, I can prepare the individual set of textures or reshape the model to fit your requirements.

description_text:
Fully printable - no support - no glue - single color 3D printer
This is a city bus toy (short version, you can also find a long version/with an (TPU)articulation in my library...)
It is completely 3d printable.The tolerance for pieces that need to fit tightly is 0.1mm,for pieces that need to allow movement (like screws and axles) 0.3mm.
Assemble video-tutorial  https://youtu.be/IdtFxOJIjbE
Printing list:  Nb. STL file name                     rezolution  support     colour

  -  2x axle_die.stl                      0.16mm      no          gray

  - 1x back_face.stl                     0.12mm      no          red/blue/black

  - either:**  1x base_front_back.stl             0.16mm      no          gray**  1x base_front_front.stl            0.16mm      no          gray
or**  1x base_front_full.stl             0.16mm      no          gray

  - either:**  1x body_front_back.stl             0.16mm      no          white/blue**  1x body_front_front.stl            0.16mm      no          white/blue
or**  1x body_front_full.stl             0.16mm      no          white/blue

  - 1x front_face.stl                    0.12mm      no          blue/white/blue

  - 1x front_number_cap.stl              0.12mm      no          blue

  - 2x rim_double.stl                    0.12mm      yes(plate)  white         

  - 2x rim_single.stl                    0.12mm      yes(plate)  white          

  - 2x screw_9mm.stl                     0.16mm      no          red         

  - 3x screw_9mm.stl                     0.16mm      no          gray    

  - 0x sleeping_screw_9mm.stl            0.16mm      no

  - 8x screw_13mm.stl                    0.16mm      no          orange    

  - 0x sleeping_screw_13mm.stl           0.16mm      no

  - 2x screw_double_wheel.stl            0.12mm      no          blue       

  - 2x screw_front_wheel.stl             0.12mm      no          white      

  - 1x sliding_doors.stl                 0.12mm      no          orange

  - 1x steering_wheel.stl                0.12mm      no          black        

  - 2x tire_bus_simple.stl               0.16mm      no          black (TPU) 

  - 4x tire_bus_with_outter_cut.stl      0.16mm      no          black (TPU)

The front face, back face and body where printed with changing the materials for a multi-colour effect:

  - body - print upside down and change the filament at the desired hight (white - blue)

  - front face - print with lights pointing up - change the filament at 3.7mm and 4.4mm (blue - white - blue)

  - back face - print with lights pointing up - change the filament at 3.6mm and 4.1mm (yellow - blue - yellow)

The model was designed in FreeCAD, I can therefore offer some other file formats, or the FreeCAD project itself.
Any improvement suggestions are very welcome!
It's my first upload here, if something does not seem ok, I probably did not notice it, so let me know.
Happy printing!
Updates:
  - base_front_back.stl has some export problem (the volume is not closed), that's why there is also a base_front_back_fixed.stl available

description_text:
screw_ladder_base_sleeping_v1.stlFully printable - no glue - single color 3D printer
Fire truck toy I designed and printed for my son.
Print with a machine that handles tolerances of 0.3-0.4 mm, if it doesn't, things won't fit together, and the ladder peaces will most probably stick to each other. Print the screws and dies with a layer not thicker than 0.16mm (did not try a coarser one, so no guaranty that it will work...), I recommend 0.12mm.Print list: quantity - stl file name - used collor - position for printing - observation:

  - 2x - die_connection_69p6mm_r6p7.stl - blue - as it is - no support

  - 1x - front_grill.stl - black - turn 90 deg over Y - no support

  - 1x - back_top.stl - yellow - as it is - no support

  - 1x - back_grill_lights.stl - red - turn 90 deg over Y - no support

  - 1x - ladder_base.stl - red - as it is - with support

  - 1x - ladder_in_out.stl - white - upside down - with support

  - 1x - cockpit.stl - black - as it is - with support

  - 1x - trunk_stairs.stl - red - turn 180 deg over Y - with support

  - 1x - cabin.stl - red - turn 90 deg over Y - with support

  - 1x - seats_2_rows.stl - black - as it is - no support

  - 1x - side_left.stl - white - turn 90 deg over X - no support

  - 1x - side_right.stl - white - turn 90 deg over X - no support

  - 2x - wheel_axle_100mm_r5p5.stl - black - as it is - no support

  - 3x - die_connection_69p6mm_r5p5.stl - blue - as it is - no support

  - 4x - screw_ladder_base.stl - yellow - as it is - no support

  - 6x - screw_20mm_filet_10mm_full.stl - yellow -  as it is - no support

  - 4x - screw_20mm_filet_10mm_full.stl - white - as it is - no support

  - 4x - screw_27mm_filet.stl - black - as it is - no support

  - 2x - fire_truck_roof_light.stl - blue - as it is - no support

  - 2x - roof_light_LEFT_HAND.stl - blue - as it is - no support

  - 1x - fire_truck_roof_light.stl - red - as it is - no support

  - 1x - roof_light_LEFT_HAND.stl - red -  as it is - no support

  - 2x - fire_truck_roof_light.stl - white - as it is - no support

  - 2x - wheel_left.stl - black - as it is - with support

  - 2x - wheel_right.stl - black - as it is - with support

  - 4x - wheel_cap.stl - white - as it is - no support

  - 1x - lader_axle_72mm_r5p5.stl  - white - as it is - no support

  - 2x - front_light.stl - blue - turn 90 deg over Y - no support

For the assembly steps check the photos. 
Hopefully I did not miss any stl files, if I did, leave a comment.
Some adjustments to the long/big parts such that the model can be printed on smaller beds (20x20cm).

  - I splited the side parts in two and connected them with two small screws.

  - Therefore do not print:
  - 1x - side_left.stl - white - turn 90 deg over X  - no support

  - 1x - side_right.stl  - white - turn 90 deg over X - no support

  - But print these instead:
  - 4x - screw_small_l12mm.stl - any - as it is - no support

  - 1x - side_left_back.stl  - white - turn 90 deg over X - with support

  - 1x - side_left_front.stl - white -  turn 90 deg over X -  no support

  - 1x - side_right_back.stl - white - turn 90 deg over X  with support

  - 1x - side_right_front.stl - white -  turn 90 deg over X - no support

  - I cut the ladder to be shorter (220mm) such that it can be printed on a 20x20cm bed diagonal.

  - Therefore do not print:  - 1x - ladder_in_out.stl - white - upside down - with support

  - But print these instead:  - 1X - ladder_short_220mm.stl  - white - upside down - with support

The model was initially posted on https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3457842
I will be posting soon my new platform for a truck toy...
The model was designed with Freecad, I can therefor also upload the Freecad project file with it...
Update 04.2021:Because the axles and/or axle screws and the ladder base screws are breaking often (if also printed with PLA) I redesigned them similar to the other truck models. For this use this:

  - axle_l100mm_new.stl instead of the original axle

  - cap_double_rim.stl instead of the original screws

  - screw_ladder_base_sleeping_v1.stl instead of the original lader base screws(prind directions as in the files)Check the last picture to understand what I mean.

description_text:
This is a fire truck toy, based on the same truck model as the concrete mixerand the tank truck models.
Fully printable, no support (except ladder), one material/colour printer. All parts should fit on a 20x20cm print bed.
Assembly video-tutorial: https://youtu.be/EwvFrpBn-Vw
The tolerance for pieces that need to fit tightly is 0.1mm,for pieces that need to allow movement (like screws and axles) 0.3mm or more.
Printing list:  Nb. STL file name                     rezolution  support   colour (my make)

  - 1x  axle_back.stl                         0.16mm       no                red

  - 1x  axle_front.stl                        0.16mm       no                red

  - 0x  back_light.stl                        0.16mm       no

Observations:

  - all objects already have the intended print direction in the STL files!

  - front_lights - if these don't fit, scale them down in your slicer 2-3-4% until these fit

  - for the cabin_with_support.stl enable thin walls

  - if you don't like the built in supports for the cabin,then you can find only the cabin in cabin_your_own_support.stl

  - most of the parts were printed with PLA. only the tires andthe mirrors were printed from TPU (flexible material)

  - screws... there are also sleeping screws STLs includedthese are printed on the side which makes them a lot strongerthe drawback is that these don't close the holes completely...So use as many sleeping screws as you can if the toy is going to be played with, and only normal/round ones otherwise

  - multi-colour-parts are printed with the same one material/colour printer,the multi-colour effect is obtained by changing the material during the print

As for everything else and the impressions overall it can be felt how much love and ingenuity and time!!!! is put into the toy by the author, love the authors attention to detail and design - some improvement still possible here and there but I would definitely consider buying more designs and printing other toys. description_text:
Create a wonderful light-up Mickey Mouse like headband. Just print the headband, 2 x Backs, 2 x Fronts, 2 x Pegs and 6 x Joints.  Insert the joints and peg into the back ear piece, then add your preferred LED lights inside each ears and just clip on the front ear piece and slide on the whole ears into the headband.
The bow slot on the top can hold a nice big bow should  your LED lights have external batteries to hide and there is a hole in the bottom corners of the ears for any LEDs wires.
The walls on the front and back ear pieces are thin to enable light to come through for most PLA colours.
Recommended print settings for headband... Infill: 20% Support Placement: Everywhere Support Overhang Angle: 58 Support Density: 5% or less (Important This makes the supports easier to remove from the brackets) Support Pattern: Zig Zag Quality: 0.2 or 0.16.
For the Front and Back Ear pieces you can increase Support Z distance to 0.3 and decrease support interface thickness to 1mm and density to 25% to enable easier removal of the support material.
Headband without bow slot and smaller child size can be found here.. https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-print-models/jewelry/other/headband-for-v5-mickey-mouse-ears
Possible LED options.https://www.amazon.com/10-Pack-Batteries-Include-Centerpiece-Decoration/dp/B07BKZS8B1/ref=sr_1_23?dchild=1&keywords=mini+led&qid=1602189310&sr=8-23

description_text:
Fully rigged and textured R2-D2 model, based on the Star Wars droid.
Native for Blender, it also supports:

  - .abc,

  - .x3d,

  - .dae,

  - .usd,

  - .fbx,

  - stereolithografy.

The preview pictures were rendered with Cycles, whereas the video was realised with the Eevee engine.
The materials are totally procedural.
The Rig includes:

  - head controls for its rotation;

  - leg and feet controls which determine the body's inclination, guaranteeing a natural and logical movement to R2 - D2

For whichever question, issue or observation, feel free to contact me.
Don't forget to rate the design if you like it!
Stay creative

description_text: I made this robot in three days. First day was modeling of the parts, second day was marking seams and assigning materials, third day was rigging, experimenting with different methods of Inverse Kinematics and animating. I made a simple walking animation, it's easily customizable from the  .blend  file and the head has keyframes for location and rotation on X, Y and Z coordinates from the Graph Editor so it looks more alive. Spheric empty is for the walking direction of the legs, cubic empty is for location offset.

description_text:
To determine the limits of my 3D Printer and its fine-tuning, I prefer to print complex models. At the same time is important to have an opportunity not only to play with the Printer capabilities, but for an aesthetic pleasure.The task is difficult, so let the model be inspiring and well-worthy of all the efforts. It could be a dancer. Bright, in an flying emotional state, all in motion, just like fire. I named it Agnia.Agniya - fiery, bright, pure (from the word Agni rus. fire, Sk. अग्नि - «fire»).

References:  https://3dladnik.wixsite.com/workshop/agnia

Printed on 3D Printer Lad-1.0: https://3dladnik.wixsite.com/workshop/lad-1-0

The most common playground design of seesaw features a board balanced in the center. A person sits on each end, and they take turns pushing their feet against the ground to lift their side into the air. Playground seesaws usually have handles for the riders to grip as they sit facing each other. One problem with the seesaw's design is that if a child allows himself/herself to hit the ground suddenly after jumping, or exits the seesaw at the bottom, the other child may fall and be injured. description_text:
This is a redesign based on the Disneyland Japan Mickey Shaped Soap.
I made this Adaptor to fit on any standard Bath and Bodyworks foaming soap pump dispenser.
How to use: https://www.facebook.com/105267271318523/videos/105274791317771/?t=1
3D PRINTING SETTINGSI recommend printing in on an SLA resin printer, but Just keep in mind that if you print in on a FDM printer, thake shure that is water proof.
Is verry important that you dont change inside mesures, that need to be more simetrical as possible.
Make sure to place supports only were that you can reach and remove or it will not work.Tip, use a curve tool to pull the supports out through the three holes at the bottom.
If you are having problems to take out those supports, try to print the arquives Half - Bottom and Half - Top and join the two parts with glue.
The secret is inside, I printed more than 10 prototips to find the better way to split the foam in the right proportion.One tip, try to use a dense soap to have a denser foam, it´ll be better. Here I´m using 8 parts of liquid soap to 2 parts of wather, but it will depend of the brand of liquid soap.

description_text:
Don't let the coronavirus infect your projects with boredom! if you need to put a lockdown on your programmer's block, let these health workers do it for you!
In addition to having their appearance modelled on actual uniforms as those depicted in contemporary media, these health workers are all fully rigged and game ready, thanks to their <1k tri counts. Use them as you wish in whatever 3d content you so wish to create!

  - Eight Hazmat workers, and one disinfectant pack

  - Based on actual PPE designs as seen in the media! 

  - Rigged and ready for animation, with moveable visors and masks.

  - Tri count: <900 tris per model.

Each one is game ready and ready for use in a low poly setting. Ideal for games designed for smartphone or tablet.
HOW TO USE THIS PACK
All files are arranged according to nationality, and models are named after the textures which they use, so for instance covid_5a.blend uses covid_5a.png and covid_5.blend, covid_5.png respectively.
Rigging is done by the use of bones representing the many joints of the character. If you are working with Unity, you will have to manipulate the bones within Unity itself.

JEEG ROBOT | RIGGED
NOTES:
The 3D models have a mid-poly definition and PBR materials
with texture sets designed to be fully compatible with most 3D software and major game engines.
Each pack comes with 3D models in BLEND and FBX formats.
The FBX format ensures the import of any model of your favorite engine.
UV Mapping is optimized for each model and materials feature
the standard PBR Metalness-Rougness system consisting of the following textures:
BaseColor, AmbientOcclusion, Metallic, Roughness, Specular, HeightMap,
NormalMapDirectX, NormalMapOpenGL. Opacity and Emission where necessary.

Smoothness URP and MaskMap HDRP (for Unity).

Use NormalMapDirectX (-Y) for 3D Studio Max, Unreal Engine, Cry Engine, Twinmotion,
GameGuru Max, S2 Engine, V-Ray, Corona.

Compatible with Blender, Maya, 3DS Max, Cinema4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Cry Engine, Twinmotion, S2 Engine HD, GameGuru Max, Arnold, Octane, V-Ray, Corona. 
Apply any transformation to the armature to move Jeeg as you like.
PBR Metallic and Dielectric materials included.
4K HDRI Included

description_text:
3D .stl model of an engagement ring created for a 7.5mm round center stone.
This ring DOES NOT include prongs or seats on the shank / outer halo.  If you are not ok with this, do NOT purchase it.  It is set up for infinity U setting.  The prongs are only in place for the renders.  This is a super old model from when I was first starting out, and my jeweler required nothing to set it (he did it all by hand) therefore there is nothing on the ring for you to use to set the diamonds.  Most jewelers prefer it that way, some prefer everything pre-cut in the model.  If you are one of those jewelers, please do not buy this model.  I do not have access to doing it for you. 
This is a very old model, but over time I have been able to dig up some of the models. I'm not exactly sure what all is on this site already but I am uploading some new file formats of the models I have found. Overall there should be 2 different varations of this ring included.

Immaculate Heart of Mary
The Immaculate Heart of Mary is a devotional name used to refer to the interior life of the Blessed Virgin Mary, her joys and sorrows, her virtues and hidden perfections, and, above all, her virginal love for God the Father, her maternal love for her son Jesus, and her compassionate love for all people.
The Eastern Catholic Churches occasionally utilize the image, devotion, and theology associated with the Immaculate Heart of Mary. However, this is a cause of some controversy, some seeing it as a form of liturgical latinisation. The Roman Catholic view is based on Mariology, as exemplified by Pope John Paul II's Apostolic Letter Rosarium Virginis Mariae. 
Traditionally, the heart is depicted pierced with seven wounds or swords, in homage to the seven dolors of Mary. Also, roses or another type of flower may be wrapped around the heart.
Veneration
Veneration of the Heart of Mary is analogous to worship of the Sacred Heart of Jesus. There are, however, differences in this analogy as devotion to the heart of Jesus is especially directed to the 'divine heart' as overflowing with love for humanity. In the devotion to Mary, however, the attraction is the love of her heart for Jesus and for God.[1]
A second difference is the nature of the devotion itself. In devotion to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, the Roman Catholic venerates in a sense of love responding to love. In devotion to the Heart of Mary, study and imitation hold as important a place as love.The aim of the devotion is to unite mankind to God through Mary's heart, and this process involves the ideas of consecration and reparation. The object of the devotion being to love God and Jesus better by uniting one's self to Mary for this purpose and by imitating her virtues.

The skull is a bony structure that forms the head in vertebrates. It supports the structures of the face and provides a protective cavity for the brain.[1] The skull is composed of two parts: the cranium and the mandible. In the human, these two parts are the neurocranium and the viscerocranium or facial skeleton that includes the mandible as its largest bone. The skull forms the anterior most portion of the skeleton and is a product of cephalisation—housing the brain, and several sensory structures such as the eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.[2] In humans these sensory structures are part of the facial skeleton.

description_text:
I have included the main mask including the upper jaw with a second piece which is the articulated low jaw. With some tweaking it should be able to move the werewolf's lower jaw with your own jaw movement, but need to use foam padding to adapt the shape, some sanding is required.
Checkout the different designs in my collection from simple cute designs to scary organic sculpts. 
Most of my work is sculpted directly in Oculus Medium VR.Most objects are separate elements which means you can mix and match to achieve the effect you want.
Take note to double check and resize accordingly before 3D printing.I have included many files of different level of details for your convenience. Refer to filename for Poly Count (K=thousands of Triangle polygons).
These are Oculus Home ready models, just copy the .GLB files, which are just binary versions of the new glTR file format into your “oculus home ->  _import” folder. 
The photos and videos are created directly in the Medium VR 3D engine.I definitely had fun creating this project from within VR. 
If you enjoy what you see then give a like or comment to support more of this effort.

From Wiki: In mathematics, a Voronoi diagram is a partition of a plane into regions close to each of a given set of objects. In the simplest case, these objects are just finitely many points in the plane (called seeds, sites, or generators). For each seed there is a corresponding region consisting of all points of the plane closer to that seed than to any other. These regions are called Voronoi cells. The Voronoi diagram of a set of points is dual to its Delaunay triangulation.The Voronoi diagram is named after Georgy Voronoy, and is also called a Voronoi tessellation, a Voronoi decomposition, a Voronoi partition, or a Dirichlet tessellation (after Peter Gustav Lejeune Dirichlet). Voronoi cells are also known as Thiessen polygons. Voronoi diagrams have practical and theoretical applications in many fields, mainly in science and technology, but also in visual art.
